title: iamar object catalogue
description: kit/catalog/catalog.json: every reusable object a world can use, searchable by plain-language description (iamar-world assets search). Generated by kit/catalog/catalog.py build from sources/ and overrides.json; never edit catalog.json by hand.

generated_from.description: Source files and the commit they were read from.

id.description: First 16 hex digits of the file's sha256 (also accepted by assets show/use), or creature:<kind>, generator:<kind>.

name.description: Plain words, lower case (camelCase, _ and - split).

kind.description: model: a glTF file; creature: built by kind via scene.creatures; generator: made by a kit command; audio: a sound file.

description_source.description: generated: assembled from name, category and numbers; written: a person or agent described what it looks like (C3).

thumbnail.description: Path relative to kit/, e.g. thumbnails/<id>.png.

style.description: Quarter or style family it was made for (e.g. iamar old town), if any.

style_compat.description: Styles it fits (C5 tags every entry; search --style filters).

size.description: [width, height, depth] in metres at scale 1 (glTF +Y up).

pivot.description: Where the origin sits, e.g. bottom-centre.

triangles.description: Triangles per LOD: {"lod0": n, "lod1": n, ...}; null while unmeasured.

collision.description: Suggested scene.json collision: none, box or mesh.

behaviours.description: What it does in a world (wander, graze, sway, door open). C4 tests each.

pairings.description: Entries that belong with it (ids or 'pack:<name>').

reuse.description: City objects reusable by default (the maintainer 2026-10-03) unless marked locked.

use.description: The command or scene.json snippet that puts it in a world.
